search_text: published ZDI-18-584 ZDI-CAN-5543 Tencent Foxmail URI parsing Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2018-06-13 CVE-2018-11616 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2018-11616 7.5 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:P/I:P/A:P ['Tencent'] ['Foxmail'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Tencent Foxmail. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the processing of URI handlers. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of the current process. Fixed in version 7.2.9 ['2018-01-25 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2018-06-13 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2018-06-13 - Advisory Updated'] rgod https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-18-584/
title: Tencent Foxmail URI parsing Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
